question: On the frozen chronological pre-holdout validation split, does treating YOLO as a proposal generator and adding the causal prefix of the original numeric training semantics remove empty-label fires without materially destroying event recall?

verbatim: 那怎么办呢  模型白训练了？怎么调整
owner_authorization.interpreted_action: Implement and evaluate the first safe repair: retain the existing YOLO checkpoint as a proposal layer, add deterministic six-MA density, candle-to-MA proximity, core-shape and already-visible confirmation checks, and compare before/after on pre-holdout validation only.

single_variable: The treatment adds one deterministic causal semantic-gate decision after the existing structural YOLO proposal filter. Images, weights, raw predictions, confidence=0.25, NMS=0.70, box-to-core mapping, ground truth and IoU=0.50 are paired and identical.

dataset.source_read_contract: Use read_preholdout_prefix. It may inspect only the boundary timestamp and must materialize zero OHLCV fields at or after the boundary.

structural_control.mapping: Map each raw normalized x edge to the nearest exact renderer candle center. y center and height do not participate.
structural_control.reason: This reproduces the completed-history structural filter that allowed the visibly sparse 4h boxes.

treatment.description: Keep a structural YOLO box only when it passes every original training-semantic predicate whose required candle is already visible at the image endpoint.
treatment.vertical_diagnostic_reason: The training labels declare full core wicks plus six MAs, but a new tolerance for imperfect predicted y geometry would be a tunable threshold. v1 records coverage and does not invent one after seeing results.

experimental_design.assignment: Every image and every raw prediction receives both conditions; no random assignment is needed because the treatment is a strict deterministic subset of control.
pairing_units: positive event after collapsing its post2-post9 variants
negative event after collapsing its three matched variants
experimental_design.null_control: Keep image, box, predicted class, confidence and IoU fixed; invert only LONG/SHORT inside the semantic calculation. Actual-direction hit survival must beat flipped-direction survival.

decision_rule.failure_action: Report failure unchanged. Do not relax a predicate, rerun a threshold grid, inspect 4h holdout to choose a threshold, train, promote or deploy.
